notes.text: Code-led build: no image generation is available in this environment, so no comp is owed. The round returned buildPath=code with buildPathFlipped=false. Ambition lives in the direction contract's FIRST VIEWPORT block and named signature interaction; the finish reviewer audits those in behaviour.

Finish review ran (impeccable-finish-reviewer), disposition: fix. All 8 material fixes applied and verified in a real browser: compact landing state (dock folds below 900px so the phone lands on the canvas), camera insets branched on the compact breakpoint, .palette de-carded to hairline rows, --text-3 lifted to 5.2-5.3:1 in both themes and legends to 10px, the three type faces self-hosted from public/fonts (zero third-party requests at runtime), the disabled filled button re-skinned from 1.96:1 to 5.28:1 and scoped so transparent variants keep their own chrome, accent taken off the wordmark, and the square-world leftovers squared (progress pills, dangling --shadow-overlay). Detector exits 0 (degraded: no HTML parser modules, so it does not evaluate computed contrast - that was measured by hand in the browser instead).

Comps phase left open on the record. This is a code-led build and no image generation exists in this environment (no OPENAI_API_KEY, no harness image tool), so no comp can be produced; the gate refuses --force without the user explicitly downgrading the comp round, and no such quote exists. Recording the state honestly rather than forcing it.

reasons: 0 comps under .impeccable\mocks; the comp round puts three compositional options of the chosen direction in front of the user (reference/visualize.md). Generate the missing ones (harness image tool or generate-image.mjs), each with a .json sidecar holding its prompt.

no comp is approved: put the three comps in front of the user (decision page via serve-question.mjs, or the structured question tool), then set "approved": true in the chosen comp's sidecar. A delegated pick is recorded the same way and disclosed.
